script.spoken: Saudia Flight 163 landed after a cargo fire. It landed safely, yet all three hundred one people aboard died. Smoke came from a fire in the rear cargo hold. The crew returned slowly and took time to stop. After landing, the jet taxied off the runway. The doors were never opened. Smoke and fire filled the cabin before rescuers got in. Airlines now stress immediate evacuation when fire is present.
